summary.title: SUMMARY
summary.description: {role} specializing in building website solutions, with 4+ websites delivered that meet UX, SEO, Core Web Vitals, WCAG, and Security standards. Seeking a {role} role to contribute to real projects and grow into a technical lead role over time.

bulletPoints.1: Built e-comerce platform using Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL to arhive
bulletPoints.2: The goal was a cheap, fast-to-deploy and can be expanded later, so I used Next.js with Server Actions instead of a separate backend. Cheaper, faster to deploy, but tight coupling to the Next.js runtime.
bulletPoints.3: Shipped in 4 weeks with zero backend hosting cost, delivering full checkout, authentication flow, multi- language support, and a scalable architecture for future expansion.

bulletPoints.1: Built a wiki and blog website to fix Discord's content management limits - posts can only be sorted by recency or date, with no flexible view options and no structured content management.
bulletPoints.2: Used MDX + Git (Fumadocs) for the wiki and a database for the blog to cut DB load, plus a NestJS monorepo for scalability — cost-efficient and well-organized, at the cost of higher initial setup.

bulletPoints.1: Built a car rental platform with car browsing and filtering, date selection, and multi-method deposits/payments - replacing manual booking processes with a self-service rental flow.
bulletPoints.2: Used Zustand for client state, RTK for server state, and a monorepo with repository pattern for scalability — smoother UX and better code organization, at the cost of higher cognitive overhead.
